blocked.reason: The request (issue #11) only asks why mathlib uses CommonJS rather than ES modules. It doesn't ask for anything in the repository to change: no ESM migration, no doc update. So there is nothing for a builder to build or a verifier to check. It should be answered in the issue thread. If the asker later wants a change, such as migrating to ES modules or documenting the module-format decision, that would be a separate request.
